descriptionText: A workflow triggered by issue_comment contains a job that checks for a slash command in the comment body (e.g. contains(github.event.comment.body, '/deploy')) without verifying the commenter's identity. Any GitHub user can trigger workflow execution, including jobs that check out and run code from a forked PR. Fix: add an authorization check such as github.event.comment.author_association == 'MEMBER' or 'OWNER' to restrict command execution to trusted contributors.
